_comment: Questions for scripts/calibrate-floor.mjs. Two groups per language: ones the documentation
answers, and ones it does not.
The undocumented ones are deliberately NOT absurd. A floor calibrated against 'what is the
recipe for tarte tatin' would be set far too high, because the real problem is the question
that shares the documentation's vocabulary while being about something else: DCS itself, a
third-party tool, the association. Those are the ones that used to reach the model dressed as
Add to these rather than replacing them — a floor is only as good as the questions it was
measured against, and the set is more useful when it grows.
